
        <h1>
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/panpeng666/p/20201154" title="发布于 2026-05-28 15:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ADO.NET入门介绍(6)</span>
    

</a>

        </h1>
        <div class="postbody">
            <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="pgc-img">
<p class="pgc-img-caption">DbCommand介绍</p>
</div>
<p data-track="2">DbCommand对象用于向数据存储区发送一条结构化查询语言(SQL)命令。DbCommand对象</p>
<p data-track="3">不仅可以执行查询，插入，更新，删除的数据操作(DML)指令，还可以执行数据定义(DDL)指令</p>
<p data-track="4">创建数据库，数据表，更改模式信息等。</p>
<p data-track="5">例如查询数据库中表基础框架</p>
<div class="pgc-img"><img class="syl-page-img lazyload" data-src="https://p11-sign.toutiaoimg.com/tos-cn-i-6w9my0ksvp/4542773bf85b4aa3b4147591855ba9a9~tplv-tt-shrink:640:0.image?lk3s=06827d14&amp;traceid=2026052815124965C7CBF3F09997E293D3&amp;x-expires=2147483647&amp;x-signature=w5GiHt%2Ffzs37vA6Z%2F35MP1v4MPs%3D">
<p class="pgc-img-caption">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p data-track="7">DbCommand需要一个合法的连接DbConnection，可以向数据储存去发送指令。</p>
<p data-track="8">一种是创建DbCommand对象，将DbConnection赋值给DbConnmand对象。</p>
<p data-track="9">另一种是通过Dbconnection对象创建DbCommand，方法为CreateCommand()</p>
<p data-track="10">查询员工的信息(employee)，展示在列表。下面是两种不同方式</p>
<div class="pgc-img"><img class="syl-page-img lazyload" data-src="https://p3-sign.toutiaoimg.com/tos-cn-i-6w9my0ksvp/a42077550c184789b2928fddff5c705d~tplv-tt-shrink:640:0.image?lk3s=06827d14&amp;traceid=2026052815124965C7CBF3F09997E293D3&amp;x-expires=2147483647&amp;x-signature=Lr%2F5IyLKC%2FRVuIuWV7m7DVyEh9Y%3D">
<p class="pgc-img-caption">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="pgc-img"><img class="syl-page-img lazyload" data-src="https://p3-sign.toutiaoimg.com/tos-cn-i-6w9my0ksvp/cc8e9a4e6ea844a189491626e0949d97~tplv-tt-shrink:640:0.image?lk3s=06827d14&amp;traceid=2026052815124965C7CBF3F09997E293D3&amp;x-expires=2147483647&amp;x-signature=Xc8z9l8dTaFifZYa2dl9z7MOgVw%3D">
<p class="pgc-img-caption">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p data-track="13">DBParameter对象</p>
<p data-track="14">在数据操作过程中，通常需要传递参数，操作数据储存区域。</p>
<p data-track="15">查询国家是英国的客户</p>
<div class="pgc-img"><img class="syl-page-img lazyload" data-src="https://p3-sign.toutiaoimg.com/tos-cn-i-6w9my0ksvp/be3b1cbd67fb447c8b6886fdc7013a34~tplv-tt-shrink:640:0.image?lk3s=06827d14&amp;traceid=2026052815124965C7CBF3F09997E293D3&amp;x-expires=2147483647&amp;x-signature=iQmnzR6DL6SFfg4RcDeXEPd0vXY%3D">
<p class="pgc-img-caption">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p data-track="17">DbCommand的执行方式，取决于是获取数据还是其他操作。</p>
<p data-track="18">如果是插入，删除，修改，使用ExecuteNonQuery()，不返回行，但是返回影响操作的行数。</p>
<p data-track="19">例如更新员工id为10的员工的 lastname</p>
<div class="pgc-img"><img class="syl-page-img lazyload" data-src="https://p26-sign.toutiaoimg.com/tos-cn-i-6w9my0ksvp/a2808737a4fe44efa1c1470926f8bfbe~tplv-tt-shrink:640:0.image?lk3s=06827d14&amp;traceid=2026052815124965C7CBF3F09997E293D3&amp;x-expires=2147483647&amp;x-signature=rN504ePM3MwQnpG3gRAY%2FsOwDfA%3D">
<p class="pgc-img-caption">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p data-track="21">其他的方法下次在介绍</p>

</div>
